Sandbox_NotTheEnd_SpawnLocation_tooltip: Sets the spawn location of the death token.
Sandbox_NotTheEnd_RecoveredStats_tooltip: Select the stats that can be recovered by the death token.
Sandbox_NotTheEnd_InitialReturnPercentag: The initial percentage of experience that can be recovered by the death token after death.
Sandbox_NotTheEnd_PenaltyIncreasePercent: The percentage by which the recovery percentage decreases after each use of the death token.
Sandbox_NotTheEnd_PenaltyCapPercentage_t: The maximum percentage to which the recovery percentage can be reduced.
Sandbox_NotTheEnd_OnlyOwnerCanConsume_to: If enabled, only the player who picked up the token can consume it.
